;Arts and culture
*[[World heritage sites]]
**In a meeting held in the city of [[Kraków]], [[Poland]], [[UNESCO]] decides not to include [[Machu Picchu]] on its [[List of World Heritage in Danger|list of endangered heritage sites]] due to the steps taken by Peruvian authorities to address concerns about the condition of the Inca citadel. [http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/latest-news/un-wont-designate-machu-picchu-endangered/news-story/c4f34ce86745727f71a8ec2a809ba2c9 (''The Australian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Alternative fuel vehicles]]
**French [[Ministry of Ecology, Sustainable Development and Energy|ecology minister]] [[Nicolas Hulot]] announces [[France]] is to ban the sale of [[Petrol engine|petrol]] and [[Diesel engine|diesel]] vehicles by [[2040]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40518293 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Leyte earthquake]]
**At least two are killed and power supply is interrupted in [[Eastern Visayas]] and [[Bohol]] when a 6.5 magnitude earthquake hits the province of [[Leyte]] in the Philippines. [http://www.interaksyon.com/magnitude-6-5-quake-hits-jaro-leyte-damage-aftershocks-expected/ (InterAksyon)]

;International relations
*[[Doklam#2017 Doklam crisis|2017 Doklam crisis]]
**Despite an ongoing stand-off between [[China]] and [[India]] over the [[Doklam|Doklam tri-junction]] which is claimed by both China and [[Bhutan]], China claims that there has been a "basic consensus" with Bhutan over the past 24 months that Doklam belongs to China and that there is no dispute between the two countries. [http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/no-dispute-with-bhutan-in-doklam-china/articleshow/59456533.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
*[[Poland–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] visits [[Warsaw]], where he speaks of defeating radical Islamist terrorism, pledges to uphold the [[North Atlantic Treaty]], and urges Russia to "join the community of responsible nations." [https://www.reviewjournal.com/news/politics-and-government/trump-likens-terrorism-fight-to-polands-resistance-to-nazis/ (''Las Vegas Review-Journal'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Mexico]]
**A [[prison riot]] between rival gangs in [[Acapulco]], [[Mexico]], leaves at least 28 inmates dead. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-40527512 (BBC)]
*The Oregon legislature passes a bill decriminalizing possession of small quantities of illegal drugs. [http://www.statesmanjournal.com/story/news/2017/07/07/racial-profiling-drug-sentencing-bill-clears-oregon-legislature/460289001/ (''Statesman Journal'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Elections in Vanuatu]]
**[[Tallis Obed Moses]] is elected [[President of Vanuatu]], succeeding the late President [[Baldwin Lonsdale]], who died in office in June. [http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/334564/tallis-obed-moses-named-as-new-vanuatu-president (RNZI)]
*[[Martial law in the Philippines]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the Philippines]] says [[President of the Philippines]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] can declare [[Martial law in the Philippines|martial law]] in the whole [[Philippines]]. Two days prior, the Supreme Court had [https://web.archive.org/web/20181204182256/http://sc.judiciary.gov.ph/pdf/web/viewer.html?file=%2Fjurisprudence%2F2017%2Fjuly2017%2F231658.pdf ruled] in favor of the constitutionality of [[Proclamation No. 216]] which declared Martial Law and [[habeas corpus|suspended the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus]] in the whole of [[Mindanao]], in response to the [[Marawi crisis]]. [http://www.rappler.com/nation/174819-sc-ruling-martial-law-duterte-nationwide (Rappler)]

;Science and technology
*[[Large Hadron Collider]]
**Scientists announce the detection of a [[Xi baryon|new subatomic particle]] at the [[Large Hadron Collider]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-40521445 (BBC)]
